command.isekai_mahou.cities.quest.no_npc: No townsperson within 24 blocks to be the giver.

command.isekai_mahou.cities.routine.stat: Townsfolk routine: %s · phase %s · time of day %s.
command.isekai_mahou.cities.start.cleare: Starting city turned off: the world spawn is back to the original.
command.isekai_mahou.cities.start.none: This world has no starting city.
command.isekai_mahou.cities.start.not_fo: No mod city was found nearby. The spawn point did not change.
command.isekai_mahou.cities.start.tp: You went to the starting city's plaza.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.citizen.tav: Another round! It's been a long day.
The inn's soup is the best in the realm.
After work, nothing beats a full mug.
Have a seat, stranger! Good stories tonight.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.merchant.cl: Closed! Come back in the morning, at sunrise.
At this hour? The shop only opens in the morning.
*yawns* We're closed... I'll serve you first thing tomorrow.
dialogue.isekai_mahou.cities.service.inn: Room booked: the bed at %s %s %s is yours for %s days. If the worst happens out there, this is where you wake up.
Done! Your room is now paid for %s days.
Fresh sheets and hot soup. There: good as new!
You slept like a log! It's morning already, and you're good as new.
Nobody told me anything worth a coin today. Keep your money.
Hold on, let me think... ask me again in a moment.
A hunter swore he saw %1$s, about %2$s blocks %3$s. They say something big lives there. I marked it on your tracker.
A traveler spoke of %1$s, about %2$s blocks %3$s. Whoever comes back doesn't come back empty-handed. I marked it on your tracker.
effect.isekai_mahou.well_rested.descript: Slept in a real bed: +15% mana regeneration and gentle healing.
message.isekai_mahou.cities.inn.last_day: Your room in %s runs out tomorrow morning.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.abandon.desc: Cancels this request. You can take another later.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.abandoned: Giving up? A pity. I'll find someone else.
A street kid! I'll have a word with the guard. Take your reward, you earned it.
Hungry...? Two children on their own? ...Tell them to come to the stall. There's work and there's food. And thank you for telling me, %s.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.apple_thief.in: %s! Someone has been stealing from my stall every morning. A townsperson saw who it was but won't get involved with me. They might tell you.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.apple_thief.re: Well, %s? Did you find the thief?
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.apple_thief.s0: I saw... it's a skinny little boy. He runs outside the wall with the food. Don't be hard on him, all right?
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.apple_thief.s1: In a hut of branches, a boy shares apples with his little sister. He stares at you, terrified.
You think of the city before yourself. So be it: more guards on the wall. And my gratitude, %s.
A fair price for dangerous work. The treasury pays.
%s, the scouts speak of monsters gathering near our lands. I need someone I can trust: thin their numbers and see with your own eyes what lies at the border stone.
You have returned, %s. What did you see at the border?
The horde is thinned. The border stone is next.
At the stone marker, tracks of every size lead away from the city. For now, they have pulled back.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.busy: You're already helping %s. One thing at a time!
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.declined: All right... if you change your mind, I'll be around.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.extra_patrol.a: That's the kind of person the guard needs. The captain will hear your name, %s.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.extra_patrol.b: Fair. Work is work. Here, from the garrison's coffer.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.extra_patrol.i: We're short-handed, %s, and the monsters have noticed. Walk a patrol for me: clear the surroundings and check the old lookout post.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.extra_patrol.s: The surroundings are clear. The lookout post is next.
From up here you can see far: fresh tracks, but no camp. For now.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.fever_tea.a.do: Thank you, truly. I'll tell everyone who looked after my son.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.fever_tea.b.do: Fair enough... here. I was saving these coins for an emergency anyway.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.fever_tea.intr: %s, my son burned with fever all night. The alchemist knows a tea that helps, but I can't leave the boy's side. Would you speak to him for me?
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.fever_tea.read: The boy is sleeping soundly now. You saved our night, %s.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.fever_tea.s0.s: A child's fever? Dandelion tea does it. But I'm out of stock... Pick four and take them straight to %2$s. Just boil them.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.fever_tea.s1: Bring %1$s× %2$s to the one who asked
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.fever_tea.s1.s: Dandelions! I'll boil them right now... There. Look, the fever is already going down. You saved our night, %1$s.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.gate_rumor.a.d: Spoken like one of us. The guard won't forget, %s.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.gate_rumor.b.d: A mercenary, eh? Fine: a job done is a job paid.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.gate_rumor.int: %s, people say something prowls by the gate at night. I can't leave my post. Hear what the folk saw and, if it's true, deal with it.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.gate_rumor.rea: So the rumor was true. Good work, %s.
I did see it! Eyes glowing in the dark, right by the gate. More than one pair. Tell %2$s I'm not making it up!
The glowing eyes won't frighten anyone again.
Open the hall doors! Tonight the whole city dines with me. And it will remember whose idea it was, %s.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.grand_feast.b: A feast for the court only
An elegant evening, then. The nobles will know how to be generous with you.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.grand_feast.in: %s, I wish to hold a feast, but the palace granaries are nearly bare. Bring me wheat, then take the order to the innkeeper: he will handle the rest.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.grand_feast.re: All is in motion, %s. One thing remains: who sits at the table?
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.grand_feast.s0: Bring %1$s× %2$s to the one who asked
Golden wheat! Excellent. Now tell the innkeeper the ovens may be lit.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.grand_feast.s1: A palace feast? Leave it to me! Bread, roast and pie. Tell %2$s it will be ready by sundown.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.hook.0: Hey, you there! Got a minute? I need a hand.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.hook.1: Adventurer! Just in time. May I ask a favor?
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.hook.2: Psst! You look trustworthy. Talk to me for a moment?
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.hook.3: Excuse me... could you possibly help me?
A deal is a deal. Here you go, with a little extra.
A customer's favor is never forgotten. Drop by anytime, %s: for you, it's the friend's price.
%s, my shop is packed and I have an overdue parcel. Take this package to another merchant in town: it's guild business, any of them will take it.
Delivered it and cleared the road too? You're worth your weight in gold, %s.
%2$s's parcel, at last! But pass this on: the supplier won't come anymore, the road is crawling with monsters.
The road is clear. The carts can roll again.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.lost_cat.a.don: May the gods repay you, %s. The whole city will hear of your kind heart.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.lost_cat.b.don: Of course! It isn't much, but it's from the heart. Dumpling thanks you.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.lost_cat.intro: %s, please! Dumpling, my cat, jumped the wall after a bird and never came back. Some neighbor must have seen which way he went. Would you bring him home?
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.lost_cat.ready: Dumpling! You rascal! ...I don't know how to thank you, %s.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.lost_cat.s0.sa: %2$s's cat? I saw him! A fat orange thing, bolting out the gate. He went into the brush.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.lost_cat.s1: Look for the cat outside the wall, %1$s
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.lost_cat.s1.sa: On a branch, an orange cat meows at you. With patience (and a few scratches), he climbs down into your arms.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.lost_cat.title: The runaway cat
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.lost_purse.a.d: It's all here! Take this. Honesty like yours is rare, %s.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.lost_purse.b.d: It's... lighter than I remember. Well, better than nothing. Thanks, I suppose.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.lost_purse.int: Oh, %s, what a disaster! I lost my purse with the month's savings. Near the gate, I think... Ask the guard if anyone found it, please!
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.lost_purse.rea: You found it?! Tell me you found it, %s!
A purse? Nobody handed one in. But a crow flew by carrying something shiny, out over the wall. I'd look there.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.lost_purse.s1: Look for the purse outside the wall, %1$s
In a low nest, among the twigs: %2$s's purse. Still heavy with coins.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.lost_recruit.a: Lost on patrol, was he? Hmm. I'll pretend I believe it. (The recruit slips some coins into your hand.)
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.lost_recruit.b: Sleeping off a hangover. I thought so. He'll scrub the stables for a month. And you, %s, have my trust.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.lost_recruit.i: %s, one of my recruits missed his shift. If the captain finds out, the lad is done for. He was last seen at the inn... Find him before the captain does.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.lost_recruit.r: Found the lad, %s? Where was he?
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.lost_recruit.s: Ask about the recruit: talk to %1$s
The recruit? Drank three mugs, said he'd go "watch the stars" and staggered out the gate. Didn't pay his tab, by the way.
Look for the recruit outside the wall, %1$s
Under a tree, the recruit snores, hugging his helmet. He wakes with a start: "Don't tell the sergeant! I'll pay you!"
You're right. I'm going now, before my courage runs out. Thank you, %s!
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.love_letter.b: Go all in on a poem
A poem! Yes! "Thine eyes are two mana crystals..." Perfect. Thank you, %s!
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.love_letter.in: %s, I need a... delicate favor. I wrote a letter to someone, but I lack the nerve to deliver it. Leave it with one of the townsfolk: everyone knows everyone here, it will arrive.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.love_letter.re: And now, %s? What do I say when we meet?
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.love_letter.s0: A letter from %2$s? Ha, I knew it! Leave it to me, it'll reach the right person. And say flowers help: poppies, preferably.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.love_letter.s1: Bring %1$s× %2$s to the one who asked
Poppies! Just what was missing. Now... what do I say when we meet, %1$s?
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.night_noises.a: Phew! So it was all in my head. Here, for your trouble.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.night_noises.b: I'd rather know the truth. I'll warn the neighbors to bar their doors. Thanks for being straight with me, %s.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.night_noises.i: %s, you look like a fighter: every night I hear growling beyond the wall. Nobody here sleeps anymore. Deal with whatever is prowling out there and tell the guard.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.night_noises.r: Well, %s? What was all that noise?
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.night_noises.s: The last monster falls. The surroundings go quiet.
All that, so close to the wall? I'll double the patrol. Tell %2$s to sleep easy.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.none: I don't need anything today, thank you.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.people_voice.a: Costly bread, taxes, boots... Few would dare tell me that. You serve this realm well, %s.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.people_voice.b: All is well? What a relief. Take this, for the good news. (Beside the throne, an advisor frowns.)
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.people_voice.i: %s, a ruler only hears what others want heard. Walk the city for me: listen to a townsperson, a merchant and a guard, and bring me the truth.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.people_voice.r: You have heard my people, %s. What do they say?
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.people_voice.s: The palace wants to know? Say the streets look lovely, but bread got expensive. And that we like it when %2$s comes down to the plaza.
For the palace? The gate taxes weigh on us, but safe roads make up for it. More guards on the caravans: that's what I'd ask.
From the palace? Then say this: too few boots, too many shifts. But nobody here abandons the wall.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.rival_prices.a: Hah! I knew they were overcharging. Tomorrow I lower mine. Here's your share.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.rival_prices.b: Caught on?! Blast. Well... better to compete honestly, then. Thanks for your candor, %s.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.rival_prices.i: %s, between us: I need to know what the competition is charging. Drop by another shop, make small talk, then bring me paper so I can write it all down.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.rival_prices.s: My prices? Best in town, of course! ...Wait. %2$s sent you, right? That old fox.
Bring %1$s× %2$s to write the prices down
Paper! Good. Now tell me everything, %1$s. Did they suspect anything?
Clean business, just how I like it. Come again, %s.
You haggle better than I do! All right, all right... take it.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.short_stock.in: You came at the right time, %s! I'm out of stock and my supplier vanished. Bring me what's missing and I'll pay well.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.short_stock.re: You warned him? Good. Let's settle up, %s.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.short_stock.s0: Bring %1$s× %2$s to the one who asked
That's it! You saved my day. One more thing: warn another merchant that my supplier vanished. He buys from the same man.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.short_stock.s1: %2$s's supplier vanished? Good to know, I was about to pay in advance. Thanks for the warning.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.thanks.0: I knew I could count on you, %s!
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.thanks.1: Thank you, %s! Come back when it's done.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.thanks.2: Wonderful! I'll be waiting right here, %s.
The city thanks you. Every one of those arrows carries your name, %s.
Right. The garrison pays its debts. Here.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.wall_arrows.in: The wall's quivers are nearly empty, %s. The blacksmith forges the heads, but we lack feathers for the shafts. Bring me some, then tell the blacksmith to start.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.wall_arrows.re: The blacksmith has started? Good. As for the feathers, %s...
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.wall_arrows.s0: Bring %1$s× %2$s to the one who asked
Good feathers. Now run to the blacksmith and say the wall's order can begin.
quest.isekai_mahou.cities.wall_arrows.s1: Arrows for the wall? About time. Tell %2$s they'll be ready before nightfall.
rumor.isekai_mahou.cities.structure.dwar: a dwarven hold under the mountain
rumor.isekai_mahou.cities.structure.garg: a tear in the sky, a Garganta
screen.isekai_mahou.cities.trade_closed: Shop closed: opens in the morning.
service.isekai_mahou.cities.inn_checkout: Gives the room back. Your respawn point goes back to what it was before.
service.isekai_mahou.cities.inn_rent3.de: The room becomes your home: you respawn there. Sleeping in the bed grants Well Rested. Renting again extends it.
service.isekai_mahou.cities.inn_rent7.de: A week of guaranteed home, for the price of two short stays.
service.isekai_mahou.cities.inn_rest.des: Sleep now: full health and mana, clears exhaustion and grants Well Rested (10 min). At night, the night passes if nobody else is awake. Free for guests.
service.isekai_mahou.cities.inn_tip_boss: Marks a nearby boss lair on your tracker. You only pay if there is a rumor.
service.isekai_mahou.cities.inn_tip_plac: Marks a nearby dungeon, tower or passage on your tracker. You only pay if there is a rumor.
